programs.title: Healthcare Assistance
programs.tagline: Emergency medical aid, life-saving medicines, and critical patient support.
programs.description: The Healthcare Assistance program provides vital medical funding for vulnerable patients facing acute illnesses, emergency treatments, diagnostic expenses, or life-saving medication costs. We honor Aban Khan by bringing healing and relief to families under health crises.
eligibilityCriteria: Patients facing acute or chronic health conditions unable to bear hospitalization or medicine costs.
Verifiable medical prescription, diagnostic report, or hospital estimate.
Priority consideration for emergency surgeries, pediatric treatments, and elderly care.
Transparent verification directly with attending clinics, hospitals, or pharmacies.
programs.requiredDocumentsNote: Upload any medical evidence: prescription slips, hospital admission estimate, diagnostic test reports, or pharmacy invoices.
programs.reviewProcessSummary: Reviewed confidentially by our medical welfare committee within 3–7 business days, with direct hospital/pharmacy settlements wherever possible.

programs.title: Educational Support
programs.tagline: Opening doors of learning, technical training, and university education in memory of Aban Khan.
programs.description: In memory of Aban Khan—a proud Electrical Engineering graduate of NED University—AWF sponsors striving students facing fee crises. We believe education provides the most durable Sadaqah Jariyah and generational empowerment.
eligibilityCriteria: Students enrolled or admitted in recognized secondary schools, technical colleges, or accredited universities.
Demonstrated academic sincerity and verifiable financial difficulty.
Coverage includes university/school tuition fees, examination dues, or essential textbooks.
Periodic academic review to sustain continuous sponsorship.
programs.requiredDocumentsNote: Upload student ID, current institution fee voucher, admission letter, or previous semester marksheet.
programs.reviewProcessSummary: Direct institutional fee transfer to university or school accounts upon review and validation.

programs.title: Essential Needs (Other Needs)
programs.tagline: Crucial household sustenance, nutritional rations, and urgent emergency relief.
programs.description: Supports families facing severe poverty, catastrophic income loss, or sudden emergency crises. From family food packages to basic household survival, we offer compassionate relief with strict recipient dignity.
eligibilityCriteria: Families facing genuine economic distress, unemployment, or loss of household breadwinner.
Priority for widows, orphans, disabled individuals, or families in urgent crises.
Willingness to provide basic verifiable contact information for private verification.
programs.requiredDocumentsNote: Upload utility bills, proof of address, or written statement of family need.
programs.reviewProcessSummary: Evaluated confidentially by the AWF welfare review panel within 5–10 business days.
